source: eval_P1_T66.md (Phase 5 single run on LOL-v1 eval15; numbers verified by tests/test_web.py)
note: Higher PSNR / SSIM and lower LPIPS / NIQE are better. Over-exposed % is the share of pixels with a channel at or above 0.98. GPU latency was measured on an RTX 3050 laptop GPU.

ablation.part: Classical: fixed instead of adaptive parameters
Fusion hybrid: without the classical branch (best variant)

findings: Natural (Retinexformer) is the most accurate: about 8 dB PSNR above the classical pipeline and about 6.3 dB above the fusion hybrid.
Highlight-safe reduces over-exposed pixels from 0.82 % to 0.03 %. Natural remains slightly better in PSNR (25.15 vs 25.12 dB) and the two are equivalent on SSIM, LPIPS and NIQE.
The fusion hybrid never comes within 4 dB of Natural, so it is kept only as a research baseline.
Thresholds were calibrated on a separate 269-image development split; the test set was used exactly once.
